data.issue_description: Laptop delivery delayed beyond the promised date of 06 September 2026. The tracking status shows 'In transit - Hyderabad hub' for the last six days. Customer was informed by a chat agent on 10 September 2026 that a query had been raised with the courier partner, but no update has been received since.
data.resolution_provided: Query raised with the courier partner, but no update received.
